entries.stage: Event entry gated by reset count
entries.requirement: Character's reset count must fall within a configured [ResetMin, ResetMax] range (or the check is disabled entirely when both are -1)
entries.target: Ability to join Blood Castle, Chaos Castle, Devil Square, or Illusion Temple
entries.notes: PHASE 6 VERIFICATION (2026-08-27): real GameServer/DATA/GameServerInfo - Event.dat confirms the mechanism exists for all 4 events (BloodCastle/ChaosCastle/DevilSquare/IllusionTemple), each with its own per-sub-level Reset AND MasterReset Min/Max fields plus a master ResetSwitch/MasterResetSwitch. RESULT: every single switch is 0 (OFF) and every Min/Max value read is 0/0 -- Blood Moon has NOT configured any non-default reset requirement on any of the 4 events. Upgraded from UNVERIFIED to CONFIRMED_BY_CONFIG because this IS now a confirmed real Blood Moon fact: the mechanism is present and built, but currently gates nothing. See atomic-claims.json CLAIM-035 for the full per-event switch list.

entries.rewardOrBenefit: 450 stat points (free/VIP tier AL0) or 500 stat points (VIP tiers AL1-3) per reset
sourceRefs: GameServer/DATA/GameServerInfo - Command.dat, "Reset Command Settings" section (real config, read 2026-08-27)
entries.notes: First progression entry in this sweep sourced entirely from real config with no provider-video basis at all -- CommandResetSwitch=1 (ENABLED). Total-reset cap differs by VIP tier: 20 for AL0/AL1/AL2, 50 for AL3 (the highest tier). No daily/weekly/monthly limit is actually enforced (all set to an effectively-unlimited 10000). See atomic-claims.json CLAIM-094.
